identity.name: Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct
identity.summary: This repository contains the instruction-tuned 14B Qwen2.5-Coder model, an official aligned model that can chat directly.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: Instruction-tuned text-output chat model with no reported evaluation of factual accuracy or grounding; code generation can produce plausible but incorrect code.

possible_risks.description: In AI-assisted decision-making tasks, reliance measures how much a person trusts (and potentially acts on) a model's output. Over-reliance occurs when a person puts too much trust in a model, accepting a model's output when the model's output is likely incorrect. Under-reliance is the opposite, where the person doesn't trust the model but should.
possible_risks.justification: Instruction-tuned chat model that can directly answer coding questions; no reported calibration or human-AI decision support evaluation, so users may over-trust generated code.

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight chat model accepts text prompts; users may paste proprietary or sensitive code into prompts, and the card reports no data handling or privacy safeguards.

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight code model accepts text prompts; users may paste copyrighted code or other IP into prompts, and the card reports no IP protections.

possible_risks.description: AI, and large generative models in particular, might produce increased carbon emissions and increase water usage for their training and operation.
possible_risks.justification: Dense decoder-only 14B model with pretraining and post-training; card reports no efficiency or environmental impact information.

specifications.model_size: 27.5 GiB of safetensors weights (29,540,133,960 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model underwent pretraining and post-training stages.
